relationships.description: Stimulant-induced formication produces crawling sensations and skin-picking phenomenologically identical to Morgellons, a documented confound and possible subgroup explanation.
Both topics invoke Borrelia persistence and biofilm (Sapi) as mechanism; Lyme arthritis is the better-evidenced test bed for those claims.
Morgellons 'infestation' phenomenology overlaps with genuine-versus-perceived parasitic infection debates and delusional infestation.
Both Morgellons (as DI) and Lyme-OCD involve neuropsychiatric symptom generation attributed by patients to infection and by mainstream medicine to brain-based mechanisms.
